exposure: usual diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
alternative diagnostic criteria for GDM during the COVID-19 pandemic
cohort: Women referred for GDM diagnosis between September 1 and November 30 in 2019 and 2020.
finding: In a Spanish population, GDM prevalence during the COVID-19 pandemic using alternative diagnostic criteria was similar to that found in 2019 using usual diagnostic criteria, and obstetrical and perinatal outcomes were comparable between the two groups despite differences in risk factors.
